title: Rent creation blocked during active maintenance period
gherkin:
Feature: Maintenance Blocking Rule
  Scenario: Prevent rent creation during active maintenance
    Given a machinery item is in an active maintenance period
    When a user attempts to create a rent for that item
    Then the rent creation request is blocked
    And an error message indicates the item is under maintenance
rationale: Core maintenance blocking behavior: the system must prevent rent creation when an item is actively undergoing maintenance, ensuring operational safety and compliance.
usedContextItems: Maintenance blocking rule prevents rent creation during maintenance periods

From: ops_lead@toolchain.com
To: dev_leads@toolchain.com, pm_team@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-02-20 14:00
Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
